g.text: Web journey analysis workflow — Page 3/5 : Core Web Vitals + HTML report
warning + report without CWV (HAR onLoad used as LCP proxy).
1. Header: date, domains, page count, source files
2. Prioritized recommendations (P1 red / P2 orange / P3 green)
4. Core Web Vitals (if cwv.json - LCP/INP/CLS with Google thresholds)
7. Appendices: EcoIndex dashboard, Network traffic, Dead code, detailed CWV
If cwv.json absent: LCP shows HAR onLoad with an explicit note.
CO2e section omitted if efootprint-python-summary.json absent.
EOF section omitted if eof-audit-results.json absent (run_eof.py not run yet).
